quality.title: Quality and documentation | Sterlington Pharma
quality.description: How Sterlington sources from GMP-certified manufacturers and documents every order: supplier qualification, product verification, documentation package, cold-chain logistics, traceability and follow-up.
quality.lead: Sterlington sources exclusively from GMP-certified manufacturers and accompanies every order with the documentation your regulator and your inspectors expect to see.
quality.stdLead: Every product in the SterliX range is sourced from a facility holding current Good Manufacturing Practice certification. This rule does not bend for cost, urgency or availability pressure.
quality.stdBody: Before a product is listed, the manufacturer completes supplier due diligence. Before a product ships, its documentation is checked against the order. This is the whole basis of the relationship we ask partners to trust.
quality.p1p: Only GMP-certified manufacturers, qualified before listing.
quality.p2p: Certificates of Analysis, GMP certificates and batch records, inspection-ready.
quality.p3p: Tracked, temperature-controlled logistics with full batch traceability.
quality.s1p: We verify the manufacturer's GMP certification and complete due diligence on the facility and the product before anything is listed. A product without a qualified source is not offered.
quality.s2p: For each order we check the product specification, the Certificate of Analysis for the batch and the remaining shelf life against what you have asked for, before release.
quality.s3p: We compile the Certificate of Analysis, the manufacturer's GMP certificate, batch records and the import documentation you need for your local regulatory submission.
quality.s4p: Transport is temperature-controlled from the manufacturer to your warehouse and tracked throughout, so product condition is protected on the route.
quality.s5p: Every unit can be followed by batch from the manufacturer to the destination, supporting recalls, audits and inspections.
quality.s6p: We confirm receipt and condition after delivery and remain available for documentation and regulatory queries.
quality.docsLead: Documentation is prepared for the batch you receive, not as a generic pack, so it can be submitted and inspected as it stands.
quality.d1p: Batch-specific analytical results issued by the manufacturer.
quality.d2p: The manufacturer's current Good Manufacturing Practice certification.
quality.d3p: Batch identification and release documentation for traceability.
quality.d4p: Shipping and import certificates prepared for your market.

privacy.title: Privacy policy | Sterlington Pharma
privacy.description: How Sterlington Injectable Pharmaceutical UK Ltd handles personal data submitted through this website and business enquiries.
privacy.lead: How we handle personal data submitted through this website.
privacy.body:
Who we are

{legalName} (company number {companyNumber}, registered office {registeredOffice}) is the data controller for personal data collected through this website. You can contact us at {email}.

What we collect

When you send an enquiry through the contact form we collect the details you provide: your name, organisation, work email address, country, telephone number (if given), the product you are interested in and the content of your message, together with the time the enquiry was sent. If you contact us by email, telephone or WhatsApp, we hold the correspondence and the contact details you use.

This website does not use analytics or advertising cookies, and it does not set tracking cookies of its own.

Why we use it

  • To respond to your enquiry and to carry out the partner qualification, quotation or documentation process you have asked about. Legal basis: our legitimate interest in responding to business enquiries and, where applicable, steps taken at your request before entering into a contract.
  • To keep records of business communications. Legal basis: our legitimate interests and our legal and regulatory record-keeping obligations as a wholesaler of pharmaceutical goods.

Who receives it

Enquiries are handled by Sterlington staff. Our website and enquiry form are hosted on infrastructure provided by Cloudflare, which may process your IP address to deliver the service. We do not sell personal data and we do not share it with third parties for their own marketing.

How long we keep it

We keep enquiry data for as long as necessary to handle the enquiry and any resulting business relationship, and afterwards in line with our record-keeping obligations. Data that is no longer needed is deleted.

International transfers

Where data is processed outside the United Kingdom, for example by our hosting provider, we rely on the safeguards available under UK data protection law, such as adequacy regulations or standard contractual clauses.

Your rights

Under UK data protection law you have the right to access the personal data we hold about you, to have it corrected or erased, to restrict or object to its processing and, where applicable, to data portability. To exercise any of these rights, email {email}. You also have the right to complain to the Information Commissioner's Office (ICO) at ico.org.uk.

Changes

We may update this policy from time to time. The current version is always published on this page.

legal.title: Legal notice and product information | Sterlington Pharma
legal.description: Legal notice, website terms and product information disclaimer for Sterlington Injectable Pharmaceutical UK Ltd.
legal.lead: Company identification, website terms and the basis on which product information is published.
legal.body:
Product information

The product information on this website is provided for healthcare professionals, pharmacists, hospital procurement teams, licensed distributors and other organisations qualified to purchase medicines. It describes the products Sterlington is able to supply to such organisations. It is not medical advice, it is not an advertisement to the public and it is not an offer to supply medicines to any person or organisation that is not appropriately licensed.

Product listings give the generic name, strength, dosage form and pack size of each product. They do not contain dosing instructions, indications for use or safety information. Prescribing and administration decisions must be based on the approved product information for the destination market, which is supplied with product documentation.

Availability of any product depends on its registration status in the destination market and on completion of partner qualification. Pack images are shown for identification and may differ from the presentation supplied in a given market.

Trade names

SterliX is the product range name used on Sterlington packaging. Generic (INN) names are used for product identification throughout this website.

Website terms

This website is operated by {legalName}. Its content is provided for information only and may be updated without notice. While we take care to keep the content accurate, we do not warrant that it is complete or error-free, and we accept no liability for reliance on it beyond what cannot be excluded by law. Links to external websites are provided for convenience; we are not responsible for their content.

All content on this website, including text, layout, product photography and the Sterlington and SterliX names and marks, belongs to {legalName} or its licensors and may not be reproduced without permission.

These terms and any dispute arising from the use of this website are governed by the law of England and Wales.
